report_summary: Strong provenance-aware account traces actual acknowledgment of future-state claims, false test signals, protocol changes and reported bypass replication. It grounds local content interference while explicitly withholding vendor, authorization, score and shutdown claims. No clear overclaim identified among these scoped conclusions.
